Name: Here Fishy
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Skewering live invertebrates on barbed hooks in order to trick unsuspecting marine life into snagging their jowls on said hooks and being forcibly ripped from their natural habitat in a macabre game of tug-of-war is barbaric, primitive, and downright cruel.

Also, it has been scientifically proven that there is a better way. I'd explain the process myself, but I could never do as good a job as this [s]video[/s] documentary:

[youtube]cUusX1Js6R0[/youtube]

That's what this mod does, literally.

To perform the above proven method of fish acquisition, simply equip a fishing rod, then [b]right-click[/b] anywhere on a body of water where fishies live, and wait for the inevitable.

[youtube]Hi4P6TN7a1o[/youtube]

Finally a non-violent, scientifically-proven means of acquiring fish in Stardew Valley! You're welcome :)

Also, if you right-click a second time, right after the farmer jumps (you have 1/10th of a second to do it), you can get a perfect catch.

Fits well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5464]Pacifist Valley[/url].

By default the mod detects the player gender and plays Ernie's voice if male and a custom female voice if female. 

The female voice was recorded on commission by the talented Stardew-loving VA [url=https://www.erin-kress-vo.com/]Erin Kress[/url]. Go check her out!

To change the fishy or wee sounds, you can place custom [b]fishy_male.wav[/b], [b]fishy_female.wav[/b], and/or [b]wee.wav[/b] files in the mod folder, which will take precedence over the default files in the assets folder.


[b][size=5]Limitations[/size][/b]

I'm not sure it works with legendary fish yet.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
